notes.title: Kindergarten 3 Patch v1.05
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday! Another week, another little patch for our dear school. This one fixes some minor bugs in Nugget's mission as well as a specific dialogue hiccup when feeding Nugget goo outside of Ms. Lovelett's mission.

[list]
[*]Fixed library door being disabled sometimes during Nugget's mission at lunch time.
[*]Fixed Nugget having wrong dialogue after he does a goo transformation on the playground when not doing teacher mission.
[*]Fixed Nugget doing the wrong thing in the hallway when talking to Stevie if you aren't in the room when his arm transforms.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.04 Patch
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday everyone! I have some good news for anyone experiencing the rare corrupted save data glitch! It should be fixed now! This patch is a little smaller because I want to make sure everyone's data is safe. I'll be monitoring the comments on this announcement, so let me know if anything is weird here.

v1.04
[list]
[*]Fixed final boss battle not resetting properly when going back to previous time periods.
[*]Fixed game not progressing if using final apple before school to help Monty.
[*]Updated save data system to be more consistent. Some players were reporting corrupted save data which should now be fixed.
[*]Spelling and grammar fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.03 Patch
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday everyone! Another week brings another patch! Thank you to everyone who has helped me find bugs! This week focuses on some of the weird stuff that can happen when restarting while the player character is being forced to walk to a certain point as well as a major sequence break in 'Gator Aid.' 

v1.03
[list]
[*]Fixed being able to skip a large portion of Gator Aid by talking to Davey in the hallway during lunch.
[*]Fixed restarting area during bunny movement not causing bunny to stop doing whatever he's doing.
[*]Fixed game freezing if you meet Alice in the hallway after she gets called into office during 'What Happened on Monday?'
[*]Fixed Alice not having correct dialogue in hallway after you tell her what's going to happen to her in the office.
[*]Fixed various instances of game breaking when restarting while player is being forced to walk to a certain point.
[*]Fixed player head sprite sometimes showing the wrong thing after starting morning time in final mission.
[*]Fixed door to library from cafeteria sometimes not being interactable when it should be.
[*]Fixed gate for playground sometimes being able to be walked through when it's supposed to be closed.
[/list]

notes.title: Kindergarten 3 Patch v1.02
notes.content:
Happy Wednesday everyone! It's been a week since launch and I'm coming through with our first round of bug fixes! This round addresses some of the more glaring bugs in the game (as anyone who jumped off the diving board after getting there from study hall will atest!). I will continue to monitor and update the game in the coming weeks as well! As for now, enjoy your Wednesday!

v1.02
[list]
[*]Fixed being able to walk while Davey is returning to toy chest during Helicopter Parenting.
[*]Blocked player from being able to walk in front of the yellow things during final mission.
[*]Fixed Carla being mad at you in morning time if you start her mission while bringing the vent map to school.
[*]Updated Lovelett dialogue after Davey and Austin stop fighting while you are not on the playground.
[*]Fixed Stevie being able to take you to the nurse during morning time if you are bleeding from the janitor.
[*]Fixed Applegate allowing player to leave during study hall while Carla is distracting by stealing the teddy.
[*]Fixed Carla doing wrong animation when reaching the bathroom before school when you bring the vent map to school.
[*]Fixed diving off board during recess if you came from study hall breaking the game.
[*]Fixed Nurse not kicking you out of classroom more than one time when she's fixing Nugget after he takes fall damage.
[/list]
